a: 301 Moved Permanently — update bookmarks; method may change on redirect.
302 Found — temporary redirect; historical method handling varies.
304 Not Modified — cached copy is still valid.
307 Temporary Redirect — preserve the HTTP method.
308 Permanent Redirect — permanent and preserve method.
405 Method Not Allowed — resource exists but method is not supported.
408 Request Timeout — server timed out waiting for the request.
415 Unsupported Media Type — Content-Type not acceptable.
429 Too Many Requests — slow down; respect Retry-After.
501 Not Implemented — server does not support the requested feature.
